profile.name: Huyen Ton Nu Bao Tien
profile.bioDraft: I am a Ph.D. candidate at Jeonbuk National University, South Korea, with research experience in veterinary virology, innate immunity, and experimental pathology. My doctoral work focuses on host–virus interactions, particularly the role of OASL1 in antiviral immune responses. My research background includes cell-based approaches, molecular techniques, immunohistochemistry, and mouse models. I am interested in contributing to collaborative, interdisciplinary research that builds on these methods and addresses fundamental questions in infection biology and immunoregulation.
profile.postdocInterestsDraft: Open to postdoctoral research opportunities that align with my experience in virology, innate immunity, molecular biology, and experimental pathology, including interdisciplinary projects where these approaches can contribute to new scientific questions.
